content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?All India Radio News's PostAll India Radio News Verified account3d · Shared with PublicLegendary singer #AshaBhosle passes away at the age of 92 in Mumbai.#AshaBhosle #RIPLegend #IndianMusic #BollywoodMusic #MusicIcon #Tribute #MumbaiAll reactions:4.8K877 comments655 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Soumya Ranjan BiswalA voice that danced across generations,A melody that never fades…Asha Bhosle is not just a singer—she is an emotion woven into the soul of Indian music. From playful cabaret songs to deeply touching ghazals, her versatility has no boundaries. Every note she sang carried life, passion, and an unmistakable charm.Her songs have been the background of countless memories—love, joy, heartbreak, celebration. She didn’t just sing music; she lived it, giving each lyric a heartbeat of its own.Even today, her voice continues to inspire, reminding us that true art never ages—it only becomes timeless.Legends like her don’t belong to time… they belong to eternity.
